text:
Alex M.: Planning a terraform apply to rotate IAM role ARNs in staging tonight (change window 23:00-00:30 PT). Canary on svc-auth, then expand. @Priya R. can you sanity-check the preflight?
Priya R.: On it. Quick checklist: lock state, run plan, verify role bindings, confirm KMS keys, and ensure deploybot fallback policy is set.
Alex M.: FYI I pinned provider version to 4.12.0 in the branch to avoid drift (provider_pin.tf)
Sam T.: Please include a rollback playbook in this thread. Last IAM rotation caused a couple 401s.
Alex M.: Rollback plan: restore TF state snapshot from s3://redwood-tf-backups/staging/1768654000, reapply previous role ARNs, and demote new roles. Notes in ops-runbook.
Priya R.: Preflight plan output looks clean. No drift. Need two approvals to proceed.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Preflight checks passed. Approvals: 0/2. To proceed run:
```
terraform apply -var-file=staging_canary.tfvars -auto-approve
```
Morgan L.: I can approve after smoke tests. Let's run the canary in single AZ first — add `-var canary_az=a` to limit blast radius.
Alex M.: Agreed. Canary will be AZ-a only. Starting manual apply in ~10m.
oncall-bot: oncall-bot: change window acknowledged by oncall (Morgan L.).
deploy-bot: deploybot: Apply started for staging-canary. Plan summary: ~12 resources to change, 4 replacements, no state locks held.
Sam T.: Watching logs. If we see >1% auth errors in 5m, initiate rollback.
Priya R.: Post-apply smoke test:
```
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' https://staging.api.redwood.ai/health | jq .status
```
deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary apply succeeded. KV cache keys preserved. Waiting 10m for metric stabilization before expansion.
Alex M.: Expanding to full staging after 10m. If metrics remain stable, we'll schedule prod run for tomorrow morning's 02:00-03:30 UTC window.
Morgan L.: Approving expansion. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploybot: Expansion apply started across AZs. Using serial AZ rollout.
Sam T.: Seeing a transient spike in 429s during expansion, within SLO. Continuing to monitor.
Priya R.: All checks green. Preparing release notes and adding provider pin and rollback steps to changelog.
Alex M.: Marking staging rotation complete. Prod will run in scheduled window; will re-open thread for prod step. Thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Thread closed. If rollback required, run: `ops rollback iam-rotate-1768654321` and notify #incidents.`
